projectionDecision.recommendation: Agree a versioned TreeDar native-artifact bundle with Viewer, preferably an explicit treedar_archive role / treedar-artifact-bundle-v1 contract and bounded manifest. Preserve every native filename, role, format, byte count and hash inside the authenticated bundle; stream/retain/ACK the exact bundle, and derive typed Viewer assets only with explicit support.
projectionDecision.v1Alternative: If Viewer explicitly defines existing tree_inventory as the versioned opaque inventory-bundle format, it could carry that bundle without widening the v1 enum. Do not silently assume that meaning: negotiate format/capability and add a shared fixture before emission.
projectionDecision.flatArtifactAlternative: A versioned result metadata extension can instead retain separate native objects using a finite declared semantic role vocabulary and exact filename/media-type metadata in both validators and Viewer ingestion. Keep native canopy height/crown labels distinct from terrain DEM.
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not map CHM/crown-label rasters to dem/orthophoto merely to satisfy the enum.
Do not relabel all binary outputs report and hide native semantics.
Do not widen only Python or only the new combined journal.

intermediateDesign.parentAwareEntry: Add a separate closed intermediate entrypoint; validate the untouched combined parent manifest/pipeline/digests and select only its exact original LiDAR object. Do not fabricate a TreeDar-only child job.
intermediateDesign.receiptAdoption: Require the journal stage intent and exact existing parent physical gate receipt/job/worker/authority/generation, actual parent claim/request/instance and scratch reservation. Verify/adopt that receipt; do not reserve a new gate or bind a new job.
intermediateDesign.reservation: Validate scratch input_bytes against whole parent manifest.totalBytes, not only LiDAR size. Adopt existing engine_started reservation and retain parent output budget. Allocate a stage-specific budget from the immutable plan.
intermediateDesign.allocation: Freeze and verify allocationBase against actual monotonic ledger allocation plus retained original inputs/ODM stage outputs. Charge TreeDar output/proof/control contributions cumulatively; do not reset allocation to LiDARbytes+Treebytes. Do not mark parent terminal or free its remaining bytes in an intermediate poll.
intermediateDesign.identity: Persist execution mode, parent/stage plan+intent+preceding proof hashes, adopted receipt, whole input bytes, allocation base, stage budget and original LiDAR binding before one Docker create/start attempt. Keep standalone identities/readers unchanged; unknown launch intents remain inspect-only.
intermediateDesign.observationVsWriters: Split read-only terminal lookup/observation from deadline stop writers and final reservation settlement. Current poll can stop containers on deadline and marks scratch terminal, so cannot be used unchanged as lookup. A lookup must never start/stop/remove, settle scratch, prepare completion, create parent outbox or release the fence.
intermediateDesign.completion: Real intermediate adapter verifies exact owned container terminal proof and retained output bytes, emits only a namespaced stage proof for PipelineJournal. Outer combined driver owns one final manifest/outbox, terminal settlement and coordinator ACK/gate release. TreeDarDelivery standalone poll/ack API is not the intermediate adapter.
intermediateDesign.leaseAndCleanup: Keep the same parent global claim/fence across ODM→TreeDar; preserve all original LiDAR/imagery and ODM outputs. Separate optional exact stopped-container cleanup from result/source acceptance lifecycle.
